# Real journal-article PDF fixtures

This directory contains two exact, unmodified, real journal-article PDFs
admitted only as hermetic fixtures for deterministic Project Koios Ingestion
software tests. Tests use these committed bytes offline and never resolve the
private acquisition staging path or retrieve a network resource.

Ingestion owns these committed fixture bytes, their attribution manifest, and
deterministic verification. References owns only the source-acquisition
crosswalk. Its private acquisition manifest has SHA-256
`1b1e8fef35b38d67e22ff02776504f863a6b143bebe6031b00db1a73783adc43`,
was generated on `2026-09-17T19:43:11.614916+00:00`, and is evidence rather
than fixture-acceptance authority or a runtime dependency. The acquisition date
recorded for both fixtures is 2026-09-17.

## License and acceptance boundaries

The repository's Apache License 2.0 applies only to Project Koios-owned code and text. It does not relicense either third-party PDF. Each PDF remains copyrighted by its stated authors and is distributed under its recorded CC BY 4.0 terms.

Fixture admission does not establish bibliographic identity promotion,
scientific correctness, relevance, citation support, extraction quality,
expected transcript correctness, publication acceptance, Workflow adoption, or
production authority. The private labels used during acquisition are not
Ingestion or References identities. Later extraction, replay, Workflow, and
publication work requires separate authorization.
